title: What the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation Means for Digital Product Passports
subtitle: How PPWR 2025/40 introduces DPP requirements for packaging across all sectors — timelines, data requirements, and links to ESPR
excerpt: The Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) 2025/40 is among the first EU regulations to mandate Digital Product Passports for packaging materials. This guide covers which packaging types are affected, what data the DPP must contain, how PPWR connects to ESPR, and the compliance timeline businesses need to plan for.
